meta.title: Soy Resinator · Full-size 3D printed replicas
meta.description: Life-size sci-fi replicas, 3D printed in Spain and shipped as a kit with their final finish. Order without creating an account.
meta.index.titulo: Soy Resinator | Life-size sci-fi replicas, 3D printed
meta.index.desc: Life-size display replicas 3D printed in Spain: real screws, removable parts and a finished look with no sanding or painting. Pick your colors and we ship it as a kit.
meta.pedido.desc: Check the status of your Soy Resinator order with your code and email.
hero.kicker: Forged layer by layer in Spain
hero.titulo: Full-size replicas for your wall, your shelf, your next convention
hero.texto: In our forge, every replica is made to measure and in the colors you choose. It arrives ready to assemble, screw together and display: no sanding, no painting.
como.intro: Replicas designed to be built like a real object, not to keep you at the workbench for weeks.
como.tornillos: Most parts join with real metric screws instead of glue. They hold firm, and you can take them apart whenever you like.
como.moviles: Removable display magazines and parts you can take out and put back. Made to be handled and displayed, not just looked at behind glass.
como.acabado: It arrives with its final finish: the color comes from the filament you choose. No filler, no sandpaper, no airbrush. Unbox, build, display.
como.envejecer_t: Make it yours, if you want
como.envejecer: Into the battle-worn look? The parts take paint and weathering with no trouble: add wear, rust or trench mud to taste.
como.pasos_titulo: From the forge to your shelf
info.kit_texto: It arrives disassembled, like flat-pack furniture. Put it together in an evening.
info.color_texto: Choose the color of the key parts from the filament we have on the shelf right now.
info.plazo_texto: We start printing when your payment arrives. Ideal shipping time: about 3 weeks from then.

desc.founders-bolt: Full-size display replica with classic, solid lines, for those who have been in this for decades. Non-functional PLA kit in the colors you choose, with all the screws included: it assembles without sanding or painting and is ready to take pride of place on your shelf. With a removable display magazine.
desc.heavy-bolt: The big piece of the forge: a full-size display replica, sturdy and packed with mechanical detail. Non-functional PLA kit in your colors, screws included; it assembles without sanding or painting and looks like a relic in any display case. With a removable display magazine.
desc.heavy-bolt-wolf: The Heavy Bolt in its pack edition, with its own special-edition palette and details the standard version doesn't have. Full-size display replica as a non-functional PLA kit, screws included, ready to assemble without sanding or painting. With a removable display magazine.
desc.founders-bolt-pistol: The compact companion of the Founders Bolt, with the same classic design. Full-size display replica as a non-functional PLA kit, in the colors you choose and with screws included, to complete your collection or your cosplay. With a removable display magazine.
desc.heavybolt-pistol: Compact version of the Heavy Bolt, with the same visual weight and the same level of detail. Full-size display replica as a non-functional PLA kit, in your colors and with screws included; it assembles without sanding or painting. With a removable display magazine.
desc.trench-las-rifle: Mud, gas and discipline turned into a collector's piece: a full-size display replica inspired by the trench regiments. Non-functional PLA kit in the colors you choose, screws included, ready to assemble and display. With a removable display magazine and a decorative bayonet (PLA, no edge).
desc.trooper-las-rifle: The line trooper's rifle, sober and recognizable at first glance, turned into a full-size display replica. Non-functional PLA kit in your colors, screws included; it assembles without sanding or painting. With a removable display magazine and a decorative bayonet (PLA, no edge).
desc.las-pistol: The small piece of the las line: a full-size display replica, light and easy to assemble. Non-functional PLA kit in the colors you choose, screws included; ideal for a cosplay or to keep the rifles company in the display case. With a removable display magazine.
desc.renegade-bolt: A relic that switched sides: a full-size display replica with corrupted ornamentation and twisted lines. Non-functional PLA kit in your colors, screws included, to assemble without sanding or painting. With a removable display magazine.
desc.founders-bolt-wolf: The Founders Bolt in its pack edition, with a fixed special-edition palette and details the standard version doesn't have. Full-size display replica as a non-functional PLA kit, screws included, ready to assemble without sanding or painting. With a removable display magazine.
desc.pulse-carabine: Otherworldly design, with clean lines and smooth surfaces that contrast with the rest of the catalog. Full-size display replica as a non-functional PLA kit, in the colors you choose and with screws included.
pago.metodo: After we confirm your order, we send you a secure Stripe payment link. Pay by card. EU customers can also pay by bank transfer.
